name: Server - Agent Card Endpoint
description: Direct stock-Connectors A2A 1.0 endpoint for a non-production blueprint. Targets engine and stock Connectors 8.9+; runtime verification pending for 8.9. The skeleton uses the legacy AI Agent Sub-process. Only combinations documented in the setup guide are verified.

properties.label: Webhook ID
properties.description: Clients read the card from {connectors base}/inbound/{webhook ID}.

properties.label: Public RPC URL
properties.description: Required complete HTTPS A2A RPC webhook URL, including any cluster prefix. Must exactly match the client's A2A_RPC_URL secret. This URL is public, not a credential; webhook response expressions use local FEEL.

pattern.message: Enter the complete HTTPS public RPC URL, including the webhook path

properties.label: Agent Card
properties.description: Describe the selected BPMN process truthfully. Keep the complete public RPC URL field, unauthenticated peer declaration and disabled capabilities.

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Name of variable to store the response in. Details in the documentation.
